cells.gaps: The evidence covers the City of Windhoek alone, and its water accounts only; no local authority outside the capital is named and no total is given. Nothing is held on governance, and the billing irregularities of July 2024 fall outside the last twelve months.
cells.note: Only the capital city is shown recording, which the ladder places at stage 2. Stage 3 needs a system live in a local government outside the capital.
